name: inspectionflow
description: InspectionFlow MVP - Arabic-first inspection and enforcement platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w @inspectionflow/engine && npm run build -w @inspectionflow/sync-client && npm run build -w @inspectionflow/api && npm run build -w @inspectionflow/web
scripts.test: npm test -w @inspectionflow/engine && npm test -w @inspectionflow/sync-client && npm test -w @inspectionflow/api
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @inspectionflow/engine && npm run dev -w @inspectionflow/api
